title: ci: a weekly merge-queue duration reading against the 22-minute median budget and the 32-minute p90 alarm
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu7EKwiyqc3GMPDoUXTEAESt)_

Fixes #35322

Supersedes #35343 (takeover: this branch starts from that PR's head and keeps its commits; the seat closed it as superseded by this PR, comment 7015137448).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Rule-change: ruled
Ruling-ref: Source: maintainer — Warren, 2026-11-19, review-split discussion thread: 03:16Z 「以上都同意」 (CI speed budget for objectstack; 「变慢两成非常大了」 rejected a 20% allowance); 04:24Z 「1+2+4」, point 2 as amended by the review: budget = median 22 min, alarm = p90 32 min, measured weekly by a script that files a speed-up card when over; a PR's own before/after reading is advisory and never blocks a merge. S1: ruling record 7044162186 on the card, 「抬到 1053,整句写进去」, under standing ruling record 6184799323 (letter B): the AGENTS.md byte ceiling 78106 → 78401 (+295 B, the measured delta of the ordered sentence; 1050 → 1053 lines).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：每周一自动量一次合并队列耗时（中位、九成、失败率、最慢的五个作业），中位超过 22 分钟或九成超过 32 分钟就自动开或刷新唯一一张提速卡；总指引文件写入这条预算规则的整句（按你的批准，总指引文件的上限放宽了这一句的长度）。
- 为什么：落实你 11-19 定的 CI 速度预算。今天实测近 7 天中位 21.9、九成 32.1 分钟，九成已经超过报警线，没人盯就会悄悄变慢。
- 最坏情况与能否撤回：量错会多开或漏开一张提速卡，不挡任何合并、不碰任何必需检查；删掉这个每周任务即可撤回。
- 需要你做的：Tier H 审批（改了自动化流程配置和总指引文件，需要你亲手批准合并）。

## What changes

- **`scripts/ci/queue-duration.mjs`** (new, read-only against GitHub). Lists every `merge_group` run created in the last `--since` window (`7d`, `24h` or an ISO instant), groups by head SHA, and for each SHA whose every queue-workflow run concluded green measures the first run's `created_at` to the last run's `updated_at` (runner waits and re-runs included). Prints p50 / p90 / max (nearest rank), the SHA counts, the queue failure rate, which workflow finished last, and the five slowest jobs of that critical run over 40 evenly spaced green SHAs. `--repo`, `--json`, `--render FILE`, `--self-test`. Exit 2 = NOT MEASURED: a window that cannot be listed whole is split in halves down to one hour and then refused, never truncated; a slice whose rows fall short of its `total_count` refuses; a sample under the budget's floor is not judged.
- **`scripts/ci/queue-budget.json`** (new): `budgetMedianMinutes: 22`, `alarmP90Minutes: 32`, `minSample: 20`, the card's baseline with its window, and the five queue workflows (the five files with a `merge_group:` trigger). Its `note` and the script header say changing a number is the maintainer's call.
- **`.github/workflows/queue-duration-budget.yml`** (new). Weekly (Monday 07:09 UTC), `workflow_dispatch`, and `pull_request` paths-filtered to its own three files. Job `measure` (`actions: read`, `contents: read`) self-tests the module, reads objectstack, reads hotcrm report-only, publishes both readings to the run summary and keeps them as an artifact; it reds only on NOT MEASURED. Job `file` (`issues: write`) runs only when the verdict is `over`, the event is not `pull_request` and the ref is `main`, and calls `fileQueueCard`: one card, fixed title plus the plain-text body marker `os-queue-duration-budget`, a bounded open-issue scan that refuses rather than files when it cannot establish absence, the oldest match refreshed in place, labels and issue type on create only. Own file rather than a `fleet-patrols.yml` job because that file's `pull_request:` paths list is frozen by `scripts/check-platform-checklist-watchdog.mjs`. No `merge_group:` or `pull_request_target:` trigger; not a required context.
- **`.github/workflows/lint.yml`**: one `run_self_test` line in the "Moved workflow step bodies self-test" collector, so `Lint & Repo Gates` runs the new self-test on every PR.
- **`docs/agents/build-and-test.md`**: the explanation behind the budget rule (whose numbers, what one reading measures, why a PR's own reading stays advisory), under the anchor `#the-merge-queue-speed-budget`. The binding sentence lives in AGENTS.md.
- **`AGENTS.md`** Build & Test: the card's item-4 sentence in full at the end of the duration paragraph, linked to the companion section: "The merge queue's speed budget is `scripts/ci/queue-budget.json`, read weekly; an over week files one speed-up card; a PR that changes CI or adds a gate reports the affected job's before/after median as advisory, never a gate." No other line is reworded or re-wrapped. Against `main` (`9d077230`): 78011 → 78306 bytes (+295), 1050 → 1053 lines.
- **`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`**: the `AGENTS.md` row in `CEILINGS` moves 78106 → 78401, exactly the +295-byte measured delta, with a row comment citing ruling record 7044162186 and standing ruling record 6184799323 (letter B). The maintainer's answer names 1053 lines because lines were the unit when the question was asked; the ratchet counts UTF-8 bytes since a457b515 landed on main, so +295 B is the byte measure of the same ordered sentence, and the line count it brings is the 1053 the answer names. The 95 bytes of headroom `main` already carried on this row are left as they stood, not spent.

### This takeover, on top of #35343's head

- **Credit:** the seven commits `fe60502e`..`e1626c63` are os-warren's and are kept as they were (no squash, no rewrite). This PR adds merges of `origin/main` (`b65488a8`, then `9d077230`) and the commits `74265b5f`, `4fdfd756` and `9ebfabcd`.
- **Cut, per the seat's order to trim to the card's Done-when:** `--via gh`, `--until` and `--job-sample`. None has a caller: the workflow passes none of them and the self-test drives the functions, not the CLI. The usage line also advertised a `--report-only` flag `main()` never read; it is gone. A cloud seat reaches the API with `node --use-env-proxy` (header and card body say so). `queue-duration.mjs` 780 → 774 lines; PR total +1055/-1 → +1050/-2.
- **Kept, with the reason for each:** `--render` (the workflow's summary step renders both JSON readings with it, one network read and two renderings); the adaptive window split (it is what makes a reading refuse rather than truncate); the critical-run job sample and the hotcrm reading (card items 1 and 3); the 270-line self-test (the Done-when's `--self-test` and its de-dup proof, battery floor and handshake per AGENTS.md "Writing a --self-test"). So the size stays well over what an M card usually reads: the bulk is the self-test and the card writer the Done-when asks for.
- **Branch name, a platform exception recorded in the claim:** this card thread can push only `claude/project-thread-aun4m7`, so the branch does not carry the `claude/issue-35322-*` spelling the Duplicate Fix Guard advises. The remote branch did not exist before the first push (`git ls-remote` answered nothing), so no force was used.
- **S2 (L2 record 7015520405), fixed in `4fdfd756`:** `listQueueRuns` now compares the rows a slice received with its `total_count` and refuses (NOT MEASURED, exit 2) a slice that falls short, so a short page that does not throw can no longer read as a smaller queue. One self-test case added (the listing battery pin 5 → 6). Ablation: with the refusal disabled the self-test exits 1 naming exactly that case; restore verified byte-identical to `HEAD`.
- **S1 (L2 record 7015520405), fixed in `9ebfabcd`** after the maintainer's ruling record 7044162186: the card's item-4 sentence is the binding spelling in AGENTS.md Build & Test, linked to the companion section, and the companion keeps the explanation only. The ceiling move is in the AGENTS.md and ratchet bullets above.
- **Duplicate Fix Guard:** #35343 was open and older and also declared the card, so this PR's "No other open PR may claim the same issue" step went red on its first run; #35343 was then retired by the seat (comment 7015137448), and a body edit re-fired the guard on `edited`, green since. No body line passes it while both are open (it has no takeover or supersedes exemption), so this body keeps the closing line the card needs and names the takeover in prose.

## Tests

<details><summary>Self-test: 54 assertions, 8 floored batteries</summary>

`node scripts/ci/queue-duration.mjs --self-test` on head `4fdfd756`:

```
✓ queue-duration --self-test: 54 assertions across 8 floored batteries.
```

Batteries: percentile and window parsing (6) · grouping by head SHA (9) · verdict, each threshold alone, sample floor, report-only (6) · listing: the adaptive split, cross-slice de-dup, a failed page fails the listing, a short page under `total_count` refuses (6) · critical-run jobs (4) · budget file, the tracked file plus six malformed shapes (7) · the card (10, including the de-dup proof: a second run sees the first run's card, refreshes it and never files a second) · rendering (6).
</details>

<details><summary>Live dry run, last 7 days on 74265b5f: p50 21.9 · p90 32.1 · max 55.6 min, OVER (p90)</summary>

`node --use-env-proxy scripts/ci/queue-duration.mjs --since 7d --json` on commit `74265b5f`, against `objectstack-ai/objectstack`, window `2026-11-12T15:55:33Z .. 2026-11-19T15:55:33Z`, 163 API reads:

- 10385 runs · 2077 head SHAs · 1837 all-green · 226 red · 12 cancelled · 2 still running
- all-green SHAs: p50 **21.9 min** · p90 **32.1 min** · max 55.6 min. Verdict OVER: p90 32.1 is over the 32-minute alarm (median 21.9 is within the 22-minute budget).
- against the card's baseline (p50 21.7 · p90 31.9 · max 34.5 over 176 SHAs, 11-17..19): percentiles within a quarter minute; this reading counts every all-green SHA in seven days, re-runs included by design, and its max is a single SHA.
- queue failure rate: 226 of 2075 completed SHAs had a red run (10.9%)
- the run that finished last: CI on 1836 of 1837 green SHAs
- slowest jobs of that run (median over 40 sampled SHAs): Test Core (9/10) 23.6 min · Test Core (10/10) 17.8 · Test Core (3/10) 17.1 · Test Core (7/8) 17.0 · Test Core (1/10) 16.2. Both shard spellings appear because the Test Core shard count changed inside the window.
- no unlisted `merge_group` workflow, no listed workflow missing.

After the S2 fix, the same command on `4fdfd756` (window `2026-11-12T16:42:04Z .. 2026-11-19T16:42:04Z`, 165 reads) listed every slice whole: 10390 runs, 1837 all-green SHAs, p50 21.9 · p90 32.1 · max 55.6, OVER.

On `main`, a weekly run with this reading would file the speed-up card. From this branch it files nothing (see Verification).

hotcrm, report-only, same commit: window `2026-11-12T16:04:00Z .. 2026-11-19T16:04:00Z`, 61 runs · 59 all-green · 2 red · p50 7 · p90 39.5 · max 41.8 min; slowest job `CI / Test shard 2` 5.6 min. Summary only; never judged, no card.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Changeset:** none. Nothing here ships in any package's `files[]` (`scripts/ci/**`, `.github/workflows/**`, `docs/agents/**`, `AGENTS.md`), so the PR carries `skip-changeset`.
- The card is filed only on an `over` week. A week back within budget writes nothing, so an open speed-up card is closed by the seat that lands the speed-up, not by this workflow.
- The job wait column (job `created_at` to `started_at`) reads 0 minutes across the sample, so it does not capture runner waiting on this repository; the waiting is inside each SHA's first-start-to-last-end span, which is what the budget grades.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:

1. `.github/workflows/queue-duration-budget.yml`, the `file` job's `if:` (the only write path: `over`, not `pull_request`, `main` only).
2. `scripts/ci/queue-duration.mjs`, `fileQueueCard` (the de-dup scan and its refusal).
3. `scripts/ci/queue-duration.mjs`, `listQueueRuns` (split or refuse, never truncate).

Two-minute check: `node scripts/ci/queue-duration.mjs --self-test` prints `✓ queue-duration --self-test: 54 assertions across 8 floored batteries.`

- S1 round on `9ebfabcd` (after merging `origin/main` `9d077230`): 64 derived commands, all exit 0, including `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` (`AGENTS.md is 78306 bytes (ceiling 78401; headroom 95)`), its `--self-test` (116 cases), `pnpm check:ratchet-remedy-authority`, `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `pnpm check:doc-authoring`, `check-adr-links` and `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (2249 cases, 336.5 s); `dispatch-gates --ran`: 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED; self-test 54 assertions; `overlap-check --branch=HEAD` `VERDICT clean exit 0`; `check-commit-card-trailers` exit 0 at push. The lychee link check of `docs/**` is CI-owned.
- Round 1 on `4fdfd756` (the S2 commit): the same 63 derived commands re-run, all exit 0, including `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (2249 cases, 326.9 s); `dispatch-gates --ran`: 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED; `overlap-check --branch=HEAD` `VERDICT clean exit 0` against origin/main `bf69cb41`; `check-commit-card-trailers` exit 0 at push.
- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` exit 0 (fast tier, 2249 cases, 318.7 s).
- `pnpm check:workflow-status-functions` exit 0.
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` exit 0 (AGENTS.md 1050 lines, at its ceiling; the edited line 116 bytes).
- `pnpm check:type-check-debt` exit 0.
